items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 28 at 12:28PM PDT until September 29 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Seas 7 to 10 ft at 14 seconds and southwest winds 15 to
25 kt expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Cape Shoalwater WA to Cape Falcon
OR out 10 NM and Waters from Cape Shoalwater WA to Cape Falcon
OR from 10 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...From 8 PM this evening to 5 PM PDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
